title: Private Cooking Demonstration of Indian Fusion Cuisine in San Diego
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private and authentic cooking class in a local home with host Nenu, an avid traveler and a self-taught cook. This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture over food. Your cooking demonstration will take place in a local home kitchen where Nenu will teach you how to make 2-3 traditional Indian fusion dishes from her family recipes that she puts her unique twist on. After cooking, you will enjoy your meal together in your host's beautiful Californian home.

• Cooking demonstration in a local Californian home
• Introduction to American culture and Indian-inspired cuisine
• 100% private activity
• Experience Indian-American hospitality in a Del Sur neighborhood residence
• Vegetarian and vegan options available
